purpose: Document official city-specific registry evidence, bounded anonymous geometry review and remaining coverage/runtime limits.
assessment: IGN’s official API Carto cadastre documentation describes open GeoJSON parcel geometry from official cadastral/Géoplateforme WFS in WGS84. A read-only query at the exact unchanged WUP point in Bordeaux commune code 33063 returned one full MultiPolygon with safe native cadastral key `idu` (33063000IX0001); only that ID and full geometry are retained.
